title: DiagGen: Agentic Generation of Deformable Assets with Sim-based Diagnostics for Robotic Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.23103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While simulation-ready deformable assets are essential for in-silico robotic manipulation tasks, existing generation frameworks typically assess physical plausibility after generation, leaving an object's simulated response unused as feedback for repairing upstream errors. We present DiagGen, an agentic framework that turns a single in-the-wild image into a simulation-ready deformable asset through a generate--simulate--diagnose--refine loop. DiagGen constructs part-aware geometry and material parameters, then uses a VLM (vision-language model)-based agent to select semantically informative regions, probe them in a physics simulator, observe material responses, and route evidence-backed repair cues to the responsible generation stage. Experiments on 40 assets show that diagnostics provides useful repair cues and can moderately improve the quality of generated deformable assets. translated_title: DiagGen：面向机器人仿真的基于仿真诊断的智能体化可变形资产生成方法
translated_abstract: 尽管可直接用于仿真的可变形资产对于计算机内的机器人操作任务至关重要，但现有的生成框架通常在生成完成后才评估物理合理性，使得物体的仿真响应无法被用作修复上游错误的反馈。我们提出了DiagGen，这是一个智能体化框架，通过“生成-仿真-诊断-精炼”的闭环流程，将单张真实场景图像转化为可直接用于仿真的可变形资产。DiagGen首先构建具有部件感知能力的几何结构与材料参数，然后利用基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体选择具有语义信息量的区域，在物理仿真器中对其进行探测，观察材料响应，并将有证据支持的修复线索传递给负责相应错误的生成阶段。在40个资产上的实验表明，诊断环节能够提供有用的修复线索，并能适度提升生成的可变形资产的质量。最后，我们展示了与仅从视觉信息生成的资产不同（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: DiagGen提出了一个智能体化框架，通过“生成-仿真-诊断-精炼”的闭环将单张真实图像转化为可直接用于仿真的可变形资产，其核心创新是利用物理仿真中的诊断结果作为反馈，将证据支持的修复线索回传至上游生成阶段来修复错误。
en_tdlr: DiagGen is an agentic framework that transforms a single in-the-wild image into simulation-ready deformable assets through a generate-simulate-diagnose-refine loop, whose key innovation is using simulation-based diagnostics as feedback to route evidence-backed repair cues to the responsible upstream generation stage.
